articles.titleTr: ChatGPT artık ödeme de yapacak! OpenAI'dan Wallet hamlesi
articles.summaryTr: OpenAI, yapay zeka ajanlarının kullanıcıların gerçek kart bilgilerine erişmeden ödeme yapmasını sağlayan ChatGPT Wallet'ı tanıttı. İlk aşamada ABD'deki sınırlı sayıda ChatGPT Pro abonesine sunulacak dijital cüzdanda her satın alma işlemi kullanıcı onayından geçecek.
articles.articleText: ChatGPT artık ödeme de yapacak! OpenAI'dan Wallet hamlesi OpenAI, yapay zeka ajanlarının kullanıcıların gerçek kart bilgilerine erişmeden ödeme yapmasını sağlayan ChatGPT Wallet'ı tanıttı. İlk aşamada ABD'deki sınırlı sayıda ChatGPT Pro abonesine sunulacak dijital cüzdanda her satın alma işlemi kullanıcı onayından geçecek. OpenAI, American Express, Mastercard ve Visa işbirliğiyle geliştirdiği ChatGPT Wallet adlı dijital cüzdan hizmetini duyurdu. Yeni özellik, yapay zeka ajanlarının kullanıcılar adına alışveriş işlemlerini tamamlamasına imkan tanıyacak. Şirketin açıklamasına göre ChatGPT Wallet, başlangıçta ABD'deki sınırlı sayıda ChatGPT Pro abonesine Dots adlı kişisel yapay zeka ajanı hizmeti üzerinden sunulacak. Kullanıcıların gerçek kart bilgileri işletmelerle veya yapay zeka ajanlarıyla paylaşılmayacak. Her ödeme için kullanıcı onayı gerekecek ChatGPT Wallet üzerinden alışveriş yapmak isteyen kullanıcılar, ödeme kartlarını sisteme bir kez tanımlayacak. Sonraki işlemlerde kart bilgilerini yeniden girmelerine gerek kalmayacak. Ancak her satın alma öncesinde ürünler, toplam tutar ve kullanılacak kart kullanıcıya gösterilecek. Ödeme, Face ID veya parmak izi gibi güvenlik kontrollerinin ardından onaylanacak. Kullanıcının onay vermesiyle ödeme ağı, gerçek kart bilgilerinin yerine geçen bir token oluşturacak. Kart numarası, güvenlik kodu ve son kullanma tarihi içeren bu token üzerinden ödeme gerçekleştirilirken gerçek kart bilgileri işletmeyle paylaşılmayacak. Yapay zeka ajanlarına alışveriş yetkisi geliyor OpenAI, ChatGPT Wallet ile işletmelerin yapay zeka ajanları aracılığıyla alışveriş yapan müşterilere hizmet verebilmesini sağlayacak araçlar ve rehberler de yayımladı. Şirket, her hafta 1,2 milyar kişinin ChatGPT'yi kullandığını ve kullanıcıların ürün araştırma, karşılaştırma ve satın alma kararlarında yapay zekadan yararlandığını belirtti. Yeni cüzdanla birlikte kullanıcıların satın alma işlemlerini de ChatGPT üzerinden tamamlamasının önü açılacak. Gelecekte harcama yetkisi tamamen ajanlara devredilebilecek OpenAI'ın gelecek döneme ilişkin hedefleri arasında kullanıcıların harcama limitleri, satın alma kategorileri ve belirli zaman aralıkları gibi sınırlar belirleyerek alışveriş işlemlerini tamamen yapay zeka ajanlarına devredebilmesi de bulunuyor. Hizmetin ilk aşamada sınırlı sayıda kullanıcıya açılacağı, gerçek kullanım deneyimleri doğrultusunda güvenlik, uyumluluk ve güvenilirlik çalışmalarının geliştirileceği bildirildi.

articles.titleTr: Borsada şirketlerden peş peşe hamleler! Milyonluk anlaşmalar ve yeni yatırımlar gündemde
articles.summaryTr: Borsa İstanbul'da işlem gören 8 şirket, yayımladıkları KAP açıklamalarıyla yeni iş ilişkileri, stratejik anlaşmalar ve yatırımlara imza attıklarını duyurdu.
articles.articleText: Borsada şirketlerden peş peşe hamleler! Milyonluk anlaşmalar ve yeni yatırımlar gündemde Borsa İstanbul'da işlem gören 8 şirket, yayımladıkları KAP açıklamalarıyla yeni iş ilişkileri, stratejik anlaşmalar ve yatırımlara imza attıklarını duyurdu. LINK, 11,5 milyon TL'lik yüz tanıma kamerası projesini tamamladı Link Bilgisayar, Emniyet Genel Müdürlüğü ile imzaladığı 11 milyon 554 bin TL bedelli KGYS yüz tanıma kamerası projesini tamamladı. Şirket, teslimat ve faturalandırma işlemlerinin gerçekleştirildiğini KAP'a bildirdi. EUPWR, TEİAŞ ihalesinde 205,9 milyon TL'lik teklifle birinci oldu Europower Enerji, TEİAŞ'ın 152 adet metal clad hücre ve yedek malzeme alımı ihalesinde en avantajlı teklifi vererek ilk sırada yer aldı. İhalenin baz bedeli 205 milyon 917 bin TL olarak açıklandı. QNBFK'den 75 milyon euroluk kredi anlaşması QNB Finansal Kiralama, uluslararası kalkınma finansmanı kuruluşu Proparco ile 75 milyon euro tutarında kredi anlaşması imzaladı. İş Leasing'den 100 milyon euro ve 30 milyon dolarlık kredi anlaşması İş Finansal Kiralama, Hollanda Kalkınma Bankası FMO liderliğindeki sendikasyon kapsamında 100 milyon euro ve 30 milyon dolar tutarında kredi sözleşmesi imzaladı. Kaynağın yeni katılımcıyla 50 milyon dolara kadar artırılması mümkün olacak. SAYAS'tan Endonezya'ya 1,3 milyon euroluk sipariş Say Yenilenebilir Enerji'nin Endonezya merkezli müşterisi PT. Kenertec Power System'e verdiği teklifler onaylandı. Toplam 1 milyon 315 bin 914 euro tutarındaki siparişin teslimatlarının 2027'nin ilk çeyreğinde tamamlanması bekleniyor. FONET, Hatay'da 216,7 milyon TL'lik ihaleyi kazandı Fonet Bilgi Teknolojileri, Hatay İl Sağlık Müdürlüğü tarafından düzenlenen 36 aylık sağlık bilgi yönetim sistemi hizmet alımı ihalesinin kazananı oldu. İhalenin bedeli 216 milyon 681 bin 840 TL olarak açıklandı. TAV Havalimanları, TAV Batum'un tamamını 3 milyon dolara satın aldı TAV Havalimanları, TAV Batum'daki yüzde 24'lük payı 3 milyon dolara devraldı. Satın alma sonrası şirketin TAV Batum'daki ortaklık oranı yüzde 76'dan yüzde 100'e yükseldi. GEN İlaç'tan 5 milyar TL'lik enerji yatırımı! Seleda'nın yüzde 81,4'ünü aldı Gen İlaç, biyogaz ve güneş enerjisi alanında faaliyet gösteren Seleda Biyogaz'ın yüzde 81,4'lük payını 5 milyar 27 milyon TL bedelle devraldı. Pay devir işlemleri 13 Kasım'da tamamlandı.

articles.title: Democratic Senate leader Schumer set to face leadership challenge
articles.summary: Maryland Senator Van Hollen says "new leadership" is needed for Democrats following the party's recent midterm successes.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Democratic Senate leader Schumer set to face leadership challenge
articles.summaryTr: Maryland Senator Van Hollen says "new leadership" is needed for Democrats following the party's recent midterm successes.
articles.articleText: Democratic Senate leader Schumer set to face leadership challenge - Published Senator Chuck Schumer is facing a challenge to his position as US Senate majority leader from his fellow Democratic Senator Chris Van Hollen, as the party prepares to take control of Congress after sweeping the midterm elections. Van Hollen, 67, said in a post on X on Thursday that Americans voted for change earlier this month and "to deliver, we need new leadership". Schumer, 75, has led Democrats in the chamber since 2017, serving as both majority and minority leader. He was first elected to the Senate in 1999. Following the midterms earlier this month, his position has come under pressure by some left-wing Democrats who see him as too moderate and part of the party establishment. Responding to the challenge, Schumer, who represents New York, said he welcomed "any discussion about the future of our caucus and the important work ahead". He added that he was "proud of what we've accomplished together" in the midterms, and he had "the votes to continue as Democratic leader". The vote on Senate leader will be held behind closed doors in early December and the winner will assume the role on 4 January, when Democrats take control of both the Senate and the House of Representatives after their midterms successes. The move by Van Hollen, who represents Maryland, marks the most significant step by a high-profile Democrat to challenge the party's existing leadership following last week's midterms victory. Announcing his plans to run in a post on X, he wrote that Americans had called on the party to "unrig an economy rigged against working people". "We should not be preserving our institutions if they are not delivering for the American people," he said at a summit in Colorado hosted by majority Democrats. "And we should be making delivering for the American people the single mission of our government, even when that means shaking things up." He added: "This country does not belong to the people who can afford to buy influence. It belongs to all of us. And it's time we govern like that." In recent years, Van Hollen has taken positions popular with those on the left of his party. In 2024, he supported restricting weapons shipments to Israel and criticised the Biden administration over its role in the war in Gaza. In an interview with MS NOW, Van Hollen - who has served in the Senate for nearly a decade - acknowledged that he was an "underdog" but added that he believed the race was "very much in flux". Independent Senator Bernie Sanders and Democratic Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed have both publicly come out in support of Van Hollen - while others have also called for new leadership. In a post on X, Sanders said he believed Van Hollen "will stand up to powerful special interests, take on the billionaire class and fight for working families". El-Sayed said the challenger would bring "bold leadership" and lead with both "courage and experience". Others Democrats have publicly backed Schumer. Senator Jacky Rosen of Nevada said: "He has the experience and the fight to continue leading our diverse caucus at this crucial moment". Senator Kirsten Gillibrand said: "You will see, despite all the grumblings, enormous gratitude for the hard work he has done to get us to this position." - Published19 hours ago - Published1 day ago - Published2 days ago

articles.summaryTr: Antalya’da düzenlenen COP31 kapsamında sanat ve iklim krizi COPArt’ta buluştu. Altı sanatçının eserlerinden oluşan seçki, geri dönüştürülmüş metallerden doğanın kırılganlığına uzanan çalışmalarla insanın çevreyle ilişkisini ve gezegenin geleceğini sorguluyor.
articles.articleText: COP31’de sanat ve iklim krizi buluştu: Altı sanatçıdan ortak çağrı - Antalya’da düzenlenen COP31 kapsamında sanat ve iklim krizi COPArt’ta buluştu. Altı sanatçının eserlerinden oluşan seçki, geri dönüştürülmüş metallerden doğanın kırılganlığına uzanan çalışmalarla insanın çevreyle ilişkisini ve gezegenin geleceğini sorguluyor. RS Sanat Alanı, Birleşmiş Milletler İklim Değişikliği 31. Taraflar Konferansı (COP31) kapsamında Antalya’da düzenlenen COPArt’ta sanatseverlerle buluşuyor. 20 Kasım’a kadar konferansın Green Zone ve Blue Zone alanlarında ziyaret edilebilen seçki; iklim acil durumunu, doğanın kırılganlığını ve insanın çevresi üzerindeki etkisini sanatın düşündüren, sorgulatan ve harekete geçiren diliyle gündeme taşıyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle RS Sanat Alanı, COPArt’taki seçkisiyle iklim acil durumuna ilişkin tartışmalara sanatın özgün bakışını da katıyor. Sanatçılara verdiği destekle farklı ifade biçimlerine alan açarken ziyaretçileri ortak bir soru etrafında buluşturuyor: Doğayla kurduğumuz ilişkiyi değiştirmek için neyi görmemiz, neyi hatırlamamız ve neyi dönüştürmemiz gerekiyor? Asaf Erdemli, Berkan Baycan, Ceylan Sakin Dökmen, Gönül Nuhoğlu, İsmet Doğan ve Murat Uçar’ın eserlerini, COP31 katılımcılarıyla buluşturan RS Sanat Alanı, farklı sanat pratiklerinin çevresel ve toplumsal meseleler etrafında diyalog kurmasına destek veriyor. Doğa, hafıza, dönüşüm ve aidiyet kavramları etrafında şekillenen çalışmalar, ziyaretçilerin insanın dünyadaki yerine ve diğer canlılarla ilişkisine yeniden bakmasını sağlıyor. Asaf Erdemli, “Bu İşte Bir Terslik Var” adlı enstalasyonunda Türkiye’nin doğal ve kültürel mirasının simgelerinden ters laleyi, geri dönüştürülmüş metaller aracılığıyla yeniden yorumluyor. Sanatçı, geri dönüşümü yalnızca bir üretim yöntemi olarak değil, doğaya ve geleceğe karşı kolektif bir sorumluluk olarak ele alıyor. Ceylan Sakin Dökmen’in “Güneş Ağacı”, “Rüzgara Kapıldım” ve “Ağıt Ağaç” adlı metal heykelleri, doğanın kırılganlığı ile yenilenme gücünü aynı yüzeyde buluşturuyor. Eserlerdeki çatlaklar ve boşluklar, kırılmanın izlerini taşırken yeniden oluşun ihtimalini de barındırıyor. Sanatçı, metalin sertliği üzerinden doğanın hassas dengelerine dikkat çekiyor. Gönül Nuhoğlu’nun “Dreaming Rhino” adlı çalışmasındaki uyuyan gergedan, iklim krizi karşısındaki kolektif kayıtsızlığın simgesine dönüşüyor. Eser, büyüyen tehditlerin gündelik yaşam içinde nasıl sıradanlaştığını sorgularken izleyiciyi kendi duyarsızlıklarıyla yüzleşmeye davet ediyor. İnsan doğaya baktığında yalnızca çevresini değil, kendi kökenlerini de görüyor. İsmet Doğan, “Kök-en” ve “Autos” serisinde insanın doğayla, geçmişiyle ve kendi varoluşuyla kurduğu bağı sorguluyor. Kökler, doğaya ait bir yaşam kaynağı olmanın yanı sıra hafızanın, kimliğin ve aidiyetin simgesi olarak beliriyor. İzleyiciyi kendi yansımasıyla eserin bir parçasına dönüştüren sanatçı, insanın doğayla bir bütün olduğunu hatırlatıyor. İklim krizinin doğayla kurduğumuz ilişkiyi yeniden düşünmeye zorladığı günümüzde, “Kök-en” temel bir soruyu gündeme getiriyor: İnsan, kendi köklerinden ne kadar uzaklaşabilir? Murat Uçar’ın eserleri, Türkiye tarihinde ilklere imza atmış 36 ismin yaşamına büyüteç aracılığıyla yakından bakmaya davet ediyor. Kolektif hafızayı şekillendiren öncü figürleri yeniden görünür kılan eserler, değişimin ardındaki insan hikâyelerini seçkinin odağına taşıyor.

articles.title: BMW'den 721 bin araç için yangın alarmı! Park uyarısı geldi
articles.summary: ABD Ulusal Kara Yolu Trafik Güvenliği İdaresi (NHTSA), yangın riski nedeniyle BMW'nin yaklaşık 721 bin aracını geri çağırdığını duyurdu. Araç sahiplerine, onarım işlemi tamamlanana kadar otomobillerini açık alana park etmeleri uyarısı yapıldı.

articles.titleTr: BMW'den 721 bin araç için yangın alarmı! Park uyarısı geldi
articles.summaryTr: ABD Ulusal Kara Yolu Trafik Güvenliği İdaresi (NHTSA), yangın riski nedeniyle BMW'nin yaklaşık 721 bin aracını geri çağırdığını duyurdu. Araç sahiplerine, onarım işlemi tamamlanana kadar otomobillerini açık alana park etmeleri uyarısı yapıldı.
articles.articleText: BMW'den 721 bin araç için yangın alarmı! Park uyarısı geldi - ABD Ulusal Kara Yolu Trafik Güvenliği İdaresi (NHTSA), yangın riski nedeniyle BMW'nin yaklaşık 721 bin aracını geri çağırdığını duyurdu. - Araç sahiplerine, onarım işlemi tamamlanana kadar otomobillerini açık alana park etmeleri uyarısı yapıldı. ABD Ulusal Kara Yolu Trafik Güvenliği İdaresi (NHTSA), Alman otomobil üreticisi BMW'nin 720 bin 796 aracını yangın riski nedeniyle geri çağırdığını açıkladı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle NHTSA tarafından yapılan açıklamada, söz konusu araçların park halindeyken ve motoru kapalıyken de yangın riski taşıdığı belirtildi. Araç sahiplerine, gerekli onarım tamamlanana kadar otomobillerini binalardan ve diğer araçlardan uzakta, açık alanlara park etmeleri tavsiye edildi. 2024'te de geri çağrılmışlardı Açıklamada, geri çağırma kapsamındaki araçların 2024 yılında su pompası kaynaklı bir sorun nedeniyle de servise çağrıldığı hatırlatıldı. Mevcut sorunun giderilmesi için araçların yeniden onarılması gerektiği bildirildi. Soruna yönelik çözümün henüz geliştirme aşamasında olduğu belirtilirken, onarım hizmetinin hazır olduğunda BMW yetkili servislerinde ücretsiz olarak sunulacağı kaydedildi. Geri çağırma hangi BMW modellerini kapsıyor? Geri çağırma kararı, 2012-2016 model yılları arasındaki bazı BMW 3 Series ve 5 Series araçlarının yanı sıra X1, X3, X4 ve X5 modellerini de kapsıyor. NHTSA'nın açıkladığı listede ayrıca Z4, 2 Series ve 4 Series modellerinin belirli üretim yıllarındaki coupe, convertible, Gran Coupe ve Sportswagon versiyonları da yer alıyor. Geri çağırma kapsamındaki araç sahiplerinin, araçlarının bu listede bulunup bulunmadığını şasi numarası (VIN) üzerinden kontrol etmesi ve onarım süreciyle ilgili BMW'den gelecek bilgilendirmeleri takip etmesi gerekiyor.

articles.title: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?
articles.summary: Microsoft says it is continuing to restore services including Outlook and Teams following a global outage.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?
articles.summaryTr: Microsoft says it is continuing to restore services including Outlook and Teams following a global outage.
articles.articleText: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost? - Published A major Microsoft outage has impacted schools, healthcare systems, businesses, courts and governments around the world. Services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot, are being restored almost 24 hours since issues first surfaced. Microsoft said the outage was not a cyber-security incident and was caused by a technical issue. It has apologised for the disruption. Here's what we know about the services affected and what went wrong. What happened? Some Microsoft 365 services have been affected by "connectivity problems" with problems reported in at least 74 countries. From late on Thursday, customers reported varying levels of access - many were unable to send or receive emails, view certain files or details on their calendar apps. But some users were able to use Teams, messaging and online meeting functions without issues. As of Friday afternoon, Microsoft said it had seen "encouraging recovery progress" in Europe and improvement in North America. The company added that it was focused on "addressing the remaining areas of disruption" but warned "some users may still experience intermittent issues". In a later statement, the company said it was continuing to see improvements "with email queues significantly reduced and approaching normal levels". The company attributed the ongoing outage to an issue during an earlier network capacity upgrade. "We have addressed the underlying issue and continue to restore service to remaining customers and regions," it said on Friday. Will emails affected by the outage ever arrive? Although services are beginning to resume, Microsoft has warned of continued "intermittent access issues", meaning some users will still struggle to load their inboxes and could experience "delayed email delivery". In other words, it is not quite safe to assume every email you send is going to arrive in its intended recipient's inbox right away. Earlier, Microsoft said it would be extending the "timeout window" to 48 hours "to help protect delayed messages as delivery catches up". The email timeout window refers to the amount of time Outlook will wait to receive an email. When they do show up, the timestamp will be when they were delivered rather than when they were sent. Why has it taken so long to fix? Although email service Outlook appears to be resuming, the outage has so far lasted for more than 20 hours - in outage terms that is considered a long time. Prof James Ferryman from the University of Reading's department of computer science said the details the company has disclosed provide some clues. "What Microsoft has told us is that the part of its servers that sets up secure connections is getting swamped, and once that happens the server just stops answering," he said. "The trouble is that this kind of failure snowballs. "One server falls over, its work gets passed to the next one, and meanwhile huge numbers of phones and laptops keep trying to get back in. "You can't just turn it all back on at once. You have to bring it back bit by bit." The challenge is therefore not just fixing the fault, but managing the huge surge of devices trying to reconnect once services start coming back online. Gergely Orosz, a former leading software engineer at several major tech companies including Skype and Uber, said this could be the "most disruptive" business email outage "of all time". He said it was still difficult to know just how many people have been affected by the disruption, but added he "cannot recall" an outage over business email ever taking this long to return to normal. Australian cyber-security expert Troy Hunt told the BBC the outage could have far-reaching consequences. "Microsoft is a massive part of the internet backbone and reminds us how critical email still is. "Not only does this outage affect many people's ability to work but also things like the ability to communicate about appointments, purchase things that need verification, create or access accounts and services," he said. In a statement, Microsoft said it was "deeply sorry for the disruption this incident has caused our customers and partners. "We know the trust they place in our services and take that responsibility extremely seriously. We are seeing broad recovery and stability across our services." How many people have been affected? More than 430 million people use Microsoft 365 apps according to Microsoft's website. The full scale of the outage has not been confirmed. Microsoft 365 is used by companies worldwide and is expected to have a knock-on effect to other services. Tech giants OpenAI and Anthropic both earlier reported problems as a result of the outage. ChatGPT-maker OpenAI said it was investigating an issue affecting its connections to Microsoft's services, which had caused some tools to not work as expected. From city governments in the US to Australian spy agencies, disruption across the globe has been widespread. Courts from Los Angeles to Texas earlier warned that communications might be delayed. In Canada, the public broadcaster CBC reported that a healthcare network running several hospitals in Toronto was experiencing email issues, but that patient care was not affected. The government of Japan also said its shared IT platform had been disrupted. Across the UK, GP surgeries, pharmacies, police and schools have been affected by the outage. Some GP surgeries had urged patients not to submit messages via their website while police forces were also earlier asking the public to call if they want to make a report. articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV is in Peru as part of his Latin America tour, just weeks after having surgery for lung cancer.

articles.titleTr: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own
articles.summaryTr: Pope Leo XIV is in Peru as part of his Latin America tour, just weeks after having surgery for lung cancer.
articles.articleText: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own - Published Pope Leo XIV has celebrated mass near the Peruvian city where he made his name as a compassionate bishop who worked closely with poor and migrant communities. The ceremony was held on Friday at a park in Pimentel, about 10km (six miles) from Chiclayo in northern Peru as part of his tour of Latin America. The Vatican estimates more than 1.5 million people gathered to welcome the pontiff. "Thank you for your affection, support and prayers," the Pope told followers. "Especially for my health during this time of trial which, with God's help, I am overcoming," he added, referencing the surgery he had for lung cancer which took place just weeks ago. Some of the crowd arrived 12 hours in advance to wait in vigil before the mass began. "We spent the night praying, alongside family, excited to welcome the Pope from Chiclayo," said Isa Orderique. Many came from across Peru and even neighbouring countries to attend. Merli Cruz Guerrero, from an area near the Ecuadorean border, travelled several hours by bus to attend. She also spent the entire night waiting. Of all the events the Pope has attended so far during his visit to Peru, this felt particularly emotional. The crowd fell into a hushed silence as the pontiff's motorcade approached. They waited eagerly for his arrival despite spending long hours out in the open with the temperature pushing past 30C. For many living here, the fact that the Pope worked extensively in this region before becoming the head of the Catholic Church has put them in the spotlight. "The Pope has come home and Chiclayo is celebrating," said Lisbeth Díaz, a teacher who worked with Pope Leo when he served as the city's bishop between 2015 and 2023. Peru is the longest stop on the first tour of Latin America by the pontiff, who was elected in May 2025. The trip has also taken in Argentina and Uruguay, but his time in this country carries particular significance. The Pope not only lived in Peru for long periods between 1985 and 2023 but also became a citizen of the country in 2015, forging close ties with local communities. Around Chiclayo, it is hard to meet anyone who doesn't claim to be a friend of the Pope or have a special anecdote about him. Some recall how he would enjoy sampling Peruvian delicacies at El Trébol, a restaurant next to the city's cathedral. Others remember his love of tennis. But for many it's the more serious moments of his time here, such as helping launch soup kitchens during the Covid-19 pandemic, or wading through deep waters on horseback when floods hit the area. Several of these images are on display in a small museum dedicated to him at the entrance to the bishop's residence. But for the city, and for a country that calls him the "Peruvian Pope", his return home means much more than a collection of photographs and anecdotes. "It is the return of the man who brought Peruvians closer to the Church," said Samuel David Miranda Atoche, a local parish priest from Chiclayo who was ordained by the Pope back when he was still the bishop and known under his birth name of Robert Prevost. And it is not just local people he connected with, according to Díaz, who came to Chiclayo from Venezuela. "It was difficult for him to see so many migrants living on the streets," she added, recalling the time when large numbers of Venezuelans came through Chiclayo escaping the political and economic crisis in their home country. "So, he got in touch with the migration authorities and coordinated with other organisations to speed up the paperwork needed for many of us to obtain legal residency and work permits." - Who is Robert Prevost, the new Pope Leo XIV? - Published9 May 2025 Robert Prevost's time here as bishop also involved difficult decisions, such as having to deal with the controversy and scandal surrounding the dissolution of Sodalitium of Christian Life, a Peruvian Catholic organisation that had faced decades of sexual abuse allegations. Santiago Roncagliolo, a Peruvian writer and journalist who has studied the Pope's life, believes his handling of that crisis earned him the favour of his predecessor, Pope Francis, and helped set him on the path to the papacy. Father David also stressed the role the now-pontiff played in bringing people together. "If there is one thing Bishop Prevost worked for here," he added, referring to the Pope by his previous title, "it was unity". That unity has been on display in the run up to the mass, with the square in front of Chiclayo Cathedral filled with joyous celebrations for days. Normally, 800,000 people live in the city and its surrounding area, but estimates say the Pope's visit has caused that to double. Local businesses have been capitalising on the Pope's popularity to boost sales and hotels have sharply increased their nightly room rates. But that didn't seem to put off the faithful who gathered for the mass. Shouts of: "The Pope is from Chiclayo!" echoed across the field during the event. Their affection was clearly reflected by the pontiff. "As I look at your faces, a prayer of thanksgiving to the Lord arises in my heart," he said from the stage, "for the blessing you have been and continue to be in my life." articles.title: Metaplanet swings to $170M loss as Bitcoin sale hits earnings
articles.summary: Bitcoin sales, valuation losses and rising borrowing costs weighed on the Japanese company’s earnings despite higher revenue and operating profit.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Metaplanet swings to $170M loss as Bitcoin sale hits earnings
articles.summaryTr: Bitcoin sales, valuation losses and rising borrowing costs weighed on the Japanese company’s earnings despite higher revenue and operating profit.
articles.articleText: Metaplanet swings to $170M loss as Bitcoin sale hits earnings Bitcoin sales, valuation losses and rising borrowing costs weighed on the Japanese company’s earnings despite higher revenue and operating profit. Metaplanet swung to a $170 million net loss in the first nine months of 2026, hit by a decline in the value of its Bitcoin holdings and a loss on the sale of 10,000 coins to demonstrate its ability to raise cash. The Japanese company, the world’s second-largest publicly traded corporate Bitcoin (BTC) holder, posted a net loss of 27.16 billion yen (about $170 million), compared with a profit of 13.53 billion yen ($84.6 million) in the same period last year. A 19.17 billion yen ($119.8 million) loss on the Bitcoin sale and an 8.04 billion yen ($50.3 million) loss from a decline in the value of its Bitcoin holdings outweighed gains in the operating business. Over the quarter, Metaplanet sold the 10,000 BTC for 124.7 billion yen and temporarily held the proceeds in cash, stablecoins and other liquid assets. It then spent 149.9 billion yen to buy 11,000 BTC, paying 9.3% more per coin on average. The company said the sale was meant to show rating agencies and bond investors that it could turn its Bitcoin into cash to meet financing obligations. At the end of September, holdings rose by a net 1,000 coins to 44,000 BTC. Top 10 largest Bitcoin treasury companies. Source: BitcoinTreasuries.NET Metaplanet borrowed against its Bitcoin holdings during the quarter, increasing the amount it owed under the credit line to $649.5 million at the end of September from $414 million at the end of June. The company said it funded Bitcoin purchases from the second quarter onward with money borrowed under the credit line, proceeds from bond sales and the exercise of stock acquisition rights, and revenue from its Bitcoin options business. Metaplanet’s interest expense rose 56% from the previous quarter to 1.36 billion yen ($8.5 million). Short-term borrowings and bonds payable totaled 110.5 billion yen ($691 million) at the end of September. For the nine months through September, revenue rose 30.5% to 5.9 billion yen ($36.9 million), while operating profit increased 26.5% to 3.48 billion yen ($21.8 million). The company cut its full-year revenue forecast to 6.5 billion yen ($40.6 million) from 16 billion yen ($100 million). Related: Metaplanet to take 93.7% stake in Super League through 2,100 BTC deal Bitcoin treasury companies face pressure from falling prices, index removals Metaplanet’s earnings come as Bitcoin treasury companies face mounting pressure from incoming stock index removals and falling Bitcoin prices. Index provider MSCI confirmed Wednesday that Strategy, Metaplanet and Upexi would be removed from its equity indexes at the Nov. 30 market close, potentially prompting funds that track those benchmarks to sell the shares. JPMorgan previously estimated that Strategy’s removal could result in roughly $2.8 billion in selling pressure from MSCI-linked funds. Bitcoin fell below $70,000 on Friday and was trading around $68,600 as of 4:51 p.m. UTC, down about 9% over the previous week, according to CoinGecko data. articles.title: 3 şirketten SPK'ya başvuru! Halka arz, birleşme ve sermaye tavanı hamleleri
articles.summary: 12-13 Kasım tarihlerinde 3 şirket, farklı kurumsal işlemler kapsamında Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu'na (SPK) başvurduğunu KAP üzerinden duyurdu. Başvurular arasında halka arz, kolaylaştırılmış birleşme ve kayıtlı sermaye tavanı artırımı öne çıktı.

articles.summaryTr: 12-13 Kasım tarihlerinde 3 şirket, farklı kurumsal işlemler kapsamında Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu'na (SPK) başvurduğunu KAP üzerinden duyurdu. Başvurular arasında halka arz, kolaylaştırılmış birleşme ve kayıtlı sermaye tavanı artırımı öne çıktı.
articles.articleText: 3 şirketten SPK'ya başvuru! Halka arz, birleşme ve sermaye tavanı hamleleri - 12-13 Kasım tarihlerinde 3 şirket, farklı kurumsal işlemler kapsamında Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu'na (SPK) başvurduğunu KAP üzerinden duyurdu. - Başvurular arasında halka arz, kolaylaştırılmış birleşme ve kayıtlı sermaye tavanı artırımı öne çıktı. SPK'ya üç şirketten halka arz, birleşme ve sermaye tavanı başvurusu geldi. Başvurular arasında yeni bir halka arz hazırlığı da yer aldı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle 12-13 Kasım 2026 tarihlerinde SPK'ya başvuru yapan şirketler ve başvuru konuları şöyle: Investco Holding (INVES) Investco Holding'in yüzde 100 bağlı ortaklığı REM Girişim Sermayesi Yatırım Ortaklığı'nın halka arz başvurusu, 12 Kasım 2026 tarihinde SPK'ya yapıldı. Ata Turizm (ATATR) Ata Turizm, yüzde 100 bağlı ortaklıkları Gökyüzü Balonculuk Taşımacılık Hizmetleri ve Kapadokya Balonculuk Ticaret Turizm şirketlerini devralmak üzere SPK'ya başvurdu. Başvuru, iki şirketin tüm aktif ve pasifleriyle birlikte tasfiyesiz şekilde Ata Turizm bünyesinde birleştirilmesini kapsıyor. Birleşmenin kolaylaştırılmış usulde gerçekleştirilmesi planlanıyor. Loras Holding (LRSHO) Loras Holding, kayıtlı sermaye tavanını 1,2 milyar TL'den 15 milyar TL'ye yükseltmek için SPK ve Ticaret Bakanlığına başvurma kararı aldı. Yeni kayıtlı sermaye tavanının 2027-2031 yılları arasında 5 yıl süreyle geçerli olması planlanıyor. Bu kapsamda şirket esas sözleşmesinin sermayeye ilişkin 7. maddesinin değiştirilmesi de kararlaştırıldı. Kayıtlı sermaye tavanı, şirketlerin esas sözleşmelerinde belirlenen ve yönetim kurulu kararıyla çıkarılmış sermayenin artırılabileceği üst sınırı ifade ediyor. Tavanın yükseltilmesi doğrudan sermaye artırımı yapıldığı anlamına gelmiyor.

İşlemler 16 Kasım'da yeniden başlıyor - Borsa İstanbul, finansal tablolarını zamanında açıklayamadığı için işlem sırası geçici olarak kapatılan Mega Polietilen Köpük (MEGAP) hisseleriyle ilgili yeni kararını duyurdu. - Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu'nun şirkete ek süre verilmesini uygun görmesinin ardından MEGAP payları 16 Kasım Pazartesi günü yeniden işleme açılacak. Borsa İstanbul tarafından 13 Kasım 2026 tarihinde Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'na (KAP) yapılan açıklamada, MEGAP.E işlem sırasının yeniden açılacağı bildirildi. MEGAP hisselerinde işlemler yeniden başlayacak CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirketin finansal tablolarını son gönderim tarihi itibarıyla KAP'a iletmemesi nedeniyle 9 Kasım'da geçici olarak kapatılan işlem sırası için yeni karar alındı. SPK'nın şirketin finansal raporlarını açıklaması için ek süre verilmesini uygun görmesi üzerine MEGAP paylarının 16 Kasım 2026 Pazartesi günü seans başlangıcından itibaren yeniden işlem görmeye başlayacağı belirtildi. Borsa İstanbul'da şirketlerin finansal raporlarını mevzuatta belirlenen sürelerde KAP'a açıklaması gerekiyor. Finansal raporların zamanında gönderilmemesi durumunda ilgili payların işlem sırası geçici olarak kapatılabiliyor.

articles.titleTr: Türkiye Sigorta'dan fon soruşturması kapsamında 1,6 milyar TL'lik ödeme
articles.summaryTr: Türkiye Sigorta (TURSG), tasfiyeye konu bazı yatırım fonlarından elde ettiği kazancın 1 milyar 599 milyon 887 bin 908 TL'lik bölümünü TMSF'ye iade etti.
articles.articleText: Türkiye Sigorta'dan fon soruşturması kapsamında 1,6 milyar TL'lik ödeme - Türkiye Sigorta (TURSG), tasfiyeye konu bazı yatırım fonlarından elde ettiği kazancın 1 milyar 599 milyon 887 bin 908 TL'lik bölümünü TMSF'ye iade etti. - Şirket, iç denetim çalışmalarının 2025 yılını da kapsayacak şekilde genişletildiğini ve ödemenin TMSF ile SPK ile yapılan görüşmeler sonucunda gönüllülük esasına göre gerçekleştirildiğini açıkladı. Türkiye Sigorta tarafından 13 Kasım 2026 tarihinde Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'na (KAP) yapılan açıklamada, şirket bünyesinde yürütülen kapsamlı iç denetim ve inceleme çalışmalarına ilişkin bilgi verildi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Açıklamada, 7 Ekim 2026 tarihli duyuruda belirtildiği üzere şirketin 30 Eylül 2026 itibarıyla tasfiyeye konu fonlarda bakiyesinin bulunmadığı hatırlatıldı. Bununla birlikte, 2025 yılını da kapsayacak şekilde genişletilen iç denetim çalışmaları sonucunda şirketin söz konusu fonların bir kısmına ilgili dönemde yürürlükte olan mevzuata ve yatırım politikasına uygun şekilde yatırım yaptığı ve bu yatırımlardan kazanç elde ettiği tespit edildi. 1,6 milyar TL'lik kazanç TMSF'ye aktarıldı Türkiye Sigorta, elde edilen kazançların mevzuata uygun olmasına rağmen şirketin etik ilkeleri ve hakkaniyet anlayışı doğrultusunda, TMSF ve SPK ile yapılan görüşmeler sonucunda gönüllü iade kararı aldığını bildirdi. İade tutarı hesaplanırken yatırım süresine isabet eden Yİ-ÜFE ve TÜFE oranlarının ortalaması üzerinden enflasyon etkisi düşüldü. Bu hesaplama sonucunda iade edilecek kazanç 1 milyar 599 milyon 887 bin 908 TL olarak belirlendi. Şirket, söz konusu tutarın 13 Kasım 2026 tarihinde TMSF hesabına yatırıldığını açıkladı. Başka ödeme yükümlülüğü beklenmiyor Şirket açıklamasında, söz konusu fonlara yapılan yatırımlarla ilgili başka bir iade veya ödeme yükümlülüğünün bulunmadığının öngörüldüğü belirtildi. Türkiye Sigorta ayrıca gerçekleştirilen ödemeye ilişkin yasal haklarının saklı olduğunu ve konuyla ilgili gelişmelerin kamuoyuyla paylaşılmaya devam edileceğini bildirdi. Türkiye Sigorta'nın açıklaması, tasfiyeye konu yatırım fonlarına yönelik incelemeler kapsamında gerçekleşen ödemelere ilişkin yeni bir gelişme oldu. Şirket, iade tutarının tamamının TMSF hesabına aktarıldığını ve hesaplamada enflasyon etkisinin düşüldüğünü özellikle vurguladı.

articles.titleTr: SASA'dan 500 milyon dolarlık yurt dışı borçlanma hamlesi! SPK'ya başvurdu
articles.summaryTr: Sasa Polyester (SASA), yurt dışında gerçekleştirmeyi planladığı borçlanma aracı ihracının tutarını 350 milyon dolardan 500 milyon dolara çıkarmak için SPK'ya başvurdu. Şirket, mevcut ihraç tavanının iptal edilerek 500 milyon dolarlık yeni ihraç tavanına onay verilmesini talep etti.
articles.articleText: SASA'dan 500 milyon dolarlık yurt dışı borçlanma hamlesi! SPK'ya başvurdu - Sasa Polyester (SASA), yurt dışında gerçekleştirmeyi planladığı borçlanma aracı ihracının tutarını 350 milyon dolardan 500 milyon dolara çıkarmak için SPK'ya başvurdu. - Şirket, mevcut ihraç tavanının iptal edilerek 500 milyon dolarlık yeni ihraç tavanına onay verilmesini talep etti. Sasa Polyester tarafından 13 Kasım 2026 tarihinde Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'na (KAP) yapılan açıklamaya göre, yönetim kurulu yurt dışı borçlanma aracı ihracına ilişkin yeni karar aldı. SASA'nın ihraç tavanı 500 milyon dolara yükseliyor CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle 30 Mart 2026 tarihli yönetim kurulu kararıyla onaylanan 350 milyon dolarlık ihraç tutarının, uluslararası sermaye piyasalarındaki koşullar dikkate alınarak 500 milyon dolara çıkarılması kararlaştırıldı. Bu kapsamda daha önce onaylanan 350 milyon dolarlık ihraç tavanının iptal edilmesi ve 500 milyon dolarlık yeni ihraç tavanı için Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu'na başvurulması kararlaştırıldı. Yurt dışında satılacak Şirketin planladığı borçlanma araçlarının halka arz edilmeksizin, çeşitli tertip ve vadelerde, tamamı yurt dışında satılması öngörülüyor. Faiz oranlarının ise ihraç tarihlerindeki piyasa koşullarına göre sabit ve/veya değişken olarak belirlenmesi planlanıyor. SASA yönetimi ayrıca yatırım kuruluşlarının yetkilendirilmesi için çalışmalara başlanmasına ve sürecin yürütülmesi konusunda üst yönetimin yetkilendirilmesine karar verdi. Şirket, 350 milyon dolarlık mevcut ihraç tavanı kapsamında henüz herhangi bir ihraç gerçekleştirilmediğini ve yeni başvuru onaylanana kadar da bu kapsamda ihraç yapılmayacağını bildirdi. Tahvil ve benzeri borçlanma araçları, şirketlerin banka kredileri dışında uluslararası sermaye piyasalarından finansman sağlamasına olanak tanıyor. SASA'nın 500 milyon dolarlık yeni ihraç tavanı talebi henüz SPK onayına tabi. İhraç tavanının onaylanması, şirketin bu tutarın tamamını hemen borçlanacağı anlamına gelmiyor.

articles.title: Rosenberg: Uncompromising Putin ups demands for peace with Ukraine
articles.summary: The fact the question of European security now features in discussions is viewed in Moscow as a victory, BBC Russia Editor Steve Rosenberg says.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Rosenberg: Uncompromising Putin ups demands for peace with Ukraine
articles.summaryTr: The fact the question of European security now features in discussions is viewed in Moscow as a victory, BBC Russia Editor Steve Rosenberg says.
articles.articleText: Rosenberg: Uncompromising Putin ups demands for peace with Ukraine - Published Russia's President Vladimir Putin says he wishes "eternal peace" for Ukraine. That is the same Russian president who ordered the full-scale invasion of Russia's neighbour nearly five years ago and who continues to reject the idea of a comprehensive ceasefire. And what, in Moscow's view, is a prerequisite for peace? The Kremlin spelt it out after talks with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner: "A new, long-term architecture of indivisible security and peace." Translated from Kremlin-speak, it means Moscow wants to change the security set-up of Europe in a way that benefits Russia. What Russia is pushing for is, potentially, the biggest change to European security arrangements since the end of the Cold War. The Kremlin has put back on the table its controversial proposal from December 2021 – the "draft treaties" with the US and Nato which would not only have put the brakes on the alliance's eastward enlargement by giving Moscow cast-iron guarantees that, for instance, Ukraine and Georgia would never be allowed to join, but also rolled back Nato military infrastructure from countries of central and eastern Europe which became Nato members following the dissolution of the Soviet Union. Western leaders dismissed such demands as an unacceptable Russian ultimatum. Two months later Moscow launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine. The "draft treaties" were put away. Now they are out of the geopolitical filing cabinet, and being quoted again by the Kremlin. What is more, Yuri Ushakov, Putin's foreign policy aide, has suggested that Moscow is about to "add certain new considerations" to its list of demands in light of Western efforts "to inflict a strategic defeat on Russia". That does not mean, of course, that Western governments will accept them. But the fact that the question of European security is featuring now in discussions on Ukraine is viewed here as a victory for Moscow. "In December 2021 Russia actively proposed that Nato rethink the security system in Europe," wrote newspaper Komsomolskaya Pravda earlier this week. "Our proposals were almost laughed at. "Having secured one victory by forcing the West to think about security, our diplomats need a second by making the West heed Russia's concerns about Nato enlargement." The EU's top diplomat, Kaja Kallas, has called Russia's demands for a new European security architecture a "trap" designed to "shift attention away from a ceasefire". "The sequencing of Ukraine-Russia talks is important," Kallas wrote on social media. "The priority should be securing a ceasefire, followed by a peace agreement. Only then can there be discussions on Europe's wider security architecture." Europe's problem is that, right now, it is not at the table. Moscow has had no desire to give it a chair. It has slammed European leaders for their military support for Kyiv and tough stance on Russia. This week's peace talks in Abu Dhabi involved Ukraine, Russia and the US. After his discussions in Moscow, Witkoff indicated that Putin had agreed to the idea of European representatives joining the next round of Ukraine peace talks. But on Friday the Kremlin indicated a final decision on European participation had not been taken. "Once we understand their true intentions and their readiness to facilitate the peace process, then it will be possible to take a decision about dialogue on Ukraine in a wider format," said Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov. - Zelensky welcomes US bringing Europe into Russia-Ukraine peace talks - Published18 hours ago - Europe's security 'fundamentally reshaped' by war in Ukraine - Published1 day ago - Inside devastated front-line city that Russia wants Ukraine to give up - Published3 days ago And what of Putin? At the talks with Witkoff and Kushner he was sounding uncompromising and confident. You can see why. The Americans are knocking at his door and seeking a deal and the Europeans are contemplating contacts with him. Last month the leaders of Norway and Finland reached out and called him. And next week in Shenzhen, China, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Co-operation summit, Putin may have a separate meeting with Donald Trump and Xi Jinping. Russian media are already comparing them to the "Big Three" - Stalin, Roosevelt and Churchill - who met in 1945 to reorganise post-World War Two Europe. And yet, after nearly five years of war, Russia has suffered huge losses on the battlefield. The Russian economy is under increasing pressure. Ukrainian drone strikes continue to target Russian oil refineries, sparking fears of new fuel shortages. But, so far, none of this has convinced the Kremlin leader to end the fighting.

articles.summaryTr: Uluslararası endeks sağlayıcısı FTSE Russell, Türkiye'nin piyasa statüsünde değişikliğe gitmedi. Türkiye, “gelişmiş gelişmekte olan piyasa” statüsünü korurken izleme listesine de alınmadı.
articles.articleText: FTSE Russell'dan Borsa İstanbul kararı: Yeni hisse eklemeleri Mart 2027'ye ertelendi - FTSE Russell, Türkiye'nin gelişmiş gelişen piyasa statüsünü korudu ancak Borsa İstanbul hisselerine yönelik kısıtlamaların devamına karar verdi. - Buna göre Borsa İstanbul'da işlem gören şirketlerin endekslere yeni dahil edilmesi ve halka açıklık oranlarındaki artışların endekslere yansıtılması en erken Mart 2027 değerlendirmesinde yeniden ele alınacak. Küresel endeks sağlayıcısı FTSE Russell, 13 Kasım 2026 tarihinde yayımladığı aralık ayı endeks değerlendirmesinde Türkiye'ye ilişkin uygulamaları duyurdu. FTSE Russell Türkiye için kararını açıkladı CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Kuruluş, Türkiye'de sermaye piyasalarının şeffaflığını artırmaya yönelik düzenlemeleri olumlu karşıladığını ancak bu adımların etkinliğini değerlendirmek için daha uzun bir gözlem süresine ihtiyaç duyulduğunu bildirdi. FTSE Russell, Türkiye'nin gelişmiş gelişen piyasalar kategorisindeki statüsünün değişmediğini ve ülkenin izleme listesine alınmadığını da teyit etti. Türkiye'nin attığı adımlar olumlu karşılandı FTSE Russell, Türkiye'de gerçekleştirilen düzenlemeler arasında ortaklık payı bildirim eşiğinin yüzde 5'ten yüzde 3'e indirilmesini, Merkezi Kayıt Kuruluşu'nun fiili dolaşım oranlarına ilişkin daha ayrıntılı veri sağlamasını ve şüpheli yüksek ortak yoğunlaşmasıyla bağlantılı bazı yatırım fonlarının tasfiyesini olumlu gelişmeler olarak sıraladı. Kuruluş ayrıca koordineli işlem faaliyetleri ve piyasa bozucu davranışlara yönelik denetim ve yaptırımların sürdüğüne dikkat çekti. Bununla birlikte düzenlemelerin etkisinin ölçülebilmesi için daha fazla zamana ihtiyaç duyulduğu vurgulandı. Borsa İstanbul'da yeni hisse eklemeleri ertelendi FTSE Russell, eylül ayında uygulamaya alınan kısıtlamaların aralık ayı değerlendirmesinde de devam edeceğini açıkladı. Bu kapsamda; Borsa İstanbul'da işlem gören şirketlerin FTSE endekslerine yeni dahil edilmesi, Halka arzlar yoluyla gerçekleştirilecek yeni eklemeler, Fiili dolaşımdaki pay oranlarındaki artışların endeks hesaplamalarına yansıtılması, Büyük, orta, küçük ve mikro ölçekli şirketler arasındaki endeks segmenti değişiklikleri en erken Mart 2027 değerlendirmesine kadar ertelenecek. Ağırlık Düzeltme Faktörü (WAF) güncellemeleri de şirketin ilgili endeksten çıkarılmasına neden olan işlemler dışında uygulanmayacak. Aralık ayında hangi işlemler yapılabilecek? Kısıtlamalara rağmen FTSE Russell, aralık ayında bazı endeks güncellemelerinin devam edeceğini bildirdi. Sektör sınıflandırması değişiklikleri, üç aylık pay sayısı güncellemeleri ve belirlenen eşikler çerçevesindeki fiili dolaşım oranı düşüşleri uygulanabilecek. Ayrıca işlem sırası kapalı olan, gözetim ve likidite kriterlerini karşılamayan veya piyasa değeri belirlenen sınırların altına düşen şirketler için endeksten çıkarma işlemleri sürdürülecek. Bölünmelerden kaynaklanan ölçek sınıfı değişiklikleri, endeks ağırlık üst sınırı güncellemeleri ve ESG, etik yatırım ile İslami yatırım kriterlerine ilişkin özel dışlama listeleri de güncellenebilecek. Gözler Mart 2027 değerlendirmesinde FTSE Russell, Türkiye'deki düzenleyici otoritelerle temasını ve piyasa gelişmelerine yönelik izleme sürecini sürdüreceğini açıkladı. Endeks değişikliklerine ilişkin kısıtlamaların kaldırılıp kaldırılmayacağına yönelik yeni kararların Mart 2027 değerlendirmesi öncesinde ele alınması bekleniyor. FTSE Russell nedir? FTSE Russell, dünya genelinde hisse senedi ve tahvil piyasalarına yönelik endeksler hazırlayan uluslararası bir endeks sağlayıcısıdır. Kuruluşun ülke sınıflandırmaları, uluslararası yatırımcıların piyasalara erişimini ve endeksleri takip eden fonların portföy dağılımlarını etkileyebiliyor.

articles.title: Galatasaray'dan Metin Öztürk ve Abdullah Kavukcu için istifa açıklaması
articles.summary: Galatasaray, yöneticilerden Abdullah Kavukcu ve Metin Öztürk'ün istifa ettiğini açıkladı.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Galatasaray'dan Metin Öztürk ve Abdullah Kavukcu için istifa açıklaması
articles.summaryTr: Galatasaray, yöneticilerden Abdullah Kavukcu ve Metin Öztürk'ün istifa ettiğini açıkladı.
articles.articleText: Galatasaray'dan Metin Öztürk ve Abdullah Kavukcu için istifa açıklaması - Galatasaray'da yaşanan Metin Öztürk-Abdullah Kavukçu kavgası iki ismin istifası ile sonuçlanmıştı. - Barıştırma çabaları sonuç vermeyince istifalar işleme konuldu. Galatasaray'da geçtiğimiz günlerde Metin Öztürk ile Abdullah Kavukcu arasında tatsız olaylar yaşanmıştı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Sarı-kırmızılu kulüp, iki yöneticinin de istifa ettiğini duyurdu. Kulüpten yapılan açıklamalarda şu ifadeler kullanıldı: "Galatasaray Spor Kulübü İkinci Başkanı Sayın Metin Öztürk, görevinden istifa etmiştir. Kendisine görev süresi boyunca kulübümüze vermiş olduğu emek ve katkılardan dolayı teşekkür ediyoruz. Galatasaray Spor Kulübü Yönetim Kurulu Üyesi Sayın Abdullah Kavukcu, görevinden istifa etmiştir. Kendisine görev süresi boyunca kulübümüze vermiş olduğu emek ve katkılardan dolayı teşekkür ediyoruz." Ne olmuştu? Metin Öztürk, 1 Kasım'da yaptığı açıklamada fiili saldırıya maruz kaldığını ve merhum annesine hakaret edildiğini öne sürmüştü. Kavukcu ise yaşananların toplantı sonrasında karşılıklı bir sözlü tartışma olduğunu iddia etmişti.

articles.titleTr: Borsa, dolar ve altın haftayı nasıl kapattı? İşte haftanın kazandıran ve kaybettiren yatırım araçları
articles.summaryTr: Borsa İstanbul'da BIST 100 endeksi haftayı yüzde 3,14 yükselişle tamamlarken, gram altın yüzde 3,53 değer kaybetti. Dolar/TL yükselirken avro/TL geriledi. Yatırım fonları arasında haftanın en çok kazandıranı ise hisse senedi fonları oldu.
articles.articleText: Borsa, dolar ve altın haftayı nasıl kapattı? İşte haftanın kazandıran ve kaybettiren yatırım araçları - Borsa İstanbul'da BIST 100 endeksi haftayı yüzde 3,14 yükselişle tamamlarken, gram altın yüzde 3,53 değer kaybetti. - Dolar/TL yükselirken euro/TL geriledi. - Yatırım fonları arasında haftanın en çok kazandıranı ise hisse senedi fonları oldu. BIST 100 endeksi hafta içinde en düşük 11.521,40, en yüksek 11.842,82 puanı gördü. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Endeks, haftalık bazda yüzde 3,14 değer kazanarak 11.842,82 puandan kapanış yaptı. Altın fiyatlarında düşüş Kapalıçarşı'da işlem gören 24 ayar külçe altının gram satış fiyatı haftalık bazda yüzde 3,53 düşüşle 6 bin 290 liraya geriledi. Cumhuriyet altınının satış fiyatı yüzde 3,45 azalarak 41 bin 448 liraya, çeyrek altının satış fiyatı ise yüzde 3,20 düşüşle 10 bin 406 liraya indi. Dolar yükseldi, euro geriledi Döviz piyasasında dolar/TL haftayı yüzde 0,42 artışla 50,3690 liradan tamamlarken, euro/TL yüzde 0,38 düşüşle 55,7140 liraya geriledi. Yatırım fonlarında hisse senedi fonları öne çıktı Yatırım fonları haftalık bazda yüzde 0,70, emeklilik fonları yüzde 1,05 değer kazandı. Yatırım fonları kategorileri incelendiğinde, yüzde 2,62 getiriyle hisse senedi fonları haftanın en çok kazandıran fon kategorisi oldu.

articles.title: CFTC Files Lawsuit Against Arkansas as the Agency Defends its Federal Jurisdiction Over Prediction Markets
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Files Lawsuit Against Arkansas as the Agency Defends its Federal Jurisdiction Over Prediction Markets
articles.articleText: Release Number 9325-26 CFTC Files Lawsuit Against Arkansas as the Agency Defends its Federal Jurisdiction Over Prediction Markets November 13, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced that it has filed a lawsuit against Arkansas to block the state’s attempts to halt event-contract trading and impose up to hundreds of millions of dollars in civil penalties on CFTC-registered exchanges. Arkansas is bringing a civil enforcement against Kalshi in state court, a CFTC-designated contract market. Arkansas’s efforts to obstruct the functions of CFTC-registered exchanges operating lawfully under the Commodity Exchange Act are preempted by federal law. “As prediction markets continue to prove their value in being useful for risk management and providing the public with valuable information about the future, Arkansas seeks to shut down event contracts ranging from sports and politics to other important world events,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “The CFTC will continue to defend its sole jurisdiction over these federally regulated markets as granted by Congress under the Commodity Exchange Act, and the Commission will not let state interference thwart its regulatory efforts and destroy federally regulated markets.” Arkansas is the 11th state the CFTC has sued to vindicate federal sovereign interests. The CFTC has also submitted amicus briefs in four federal Courts of Appeal and one state Supreme Court. -CFTC-

articles.articleText: German spies handed new powers to tackle 'hybrid threats' from abroad - Published Germany's foreign and domestic intelligence services are to be given greater powers to combat espionage, terrorism and sabotage after the country's parliament, the Bundestag, approved a major overhaul of its legislation. Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt, who championed the bill, has called it a "reform of the century", necessary because of the increasing threats from foreign powers. But the Left Party's security spokeswoman, Clara Bünger, said Dobrindt was creating a new German secret police. The legislation gives numerous new powers to Germany's BND federal intelligence service, and its BfV domestic service, the Federal Office for the Protection of the Constitution. In the Bundestag, 309 MPs voted in favour of the new law on intelligence services, while 190 voted against and 71 abstained. For historical reasons, German intelligence has mainly focused on gathering information rather than acting on it. In future, German spies working for the BND, which is responsible for foreign intelligence, will be able to conduct covert operations abroad, including sabotage. This could include paralysing the servers of state-sponsored hacker groups, disrupting disinformation networks, or even disrupting supply chains for weapons. Agents for the domestic intelligence service, the BfV, will no longer to be limited to gathering information. For the first time they will be able to take protective action against property and IT systems, if specific threats are identified. That means they will be allowed to dismantle or break explosives or weapons, divert or block data flows during cyber-attacks, delete or falsify data stored for malicious purposes, and plant false information on those involved. - Sabotage suspect held in Germany after spate of attacks on power grid - Published8 September - Germany says Russia behind Leipzig airport drone attack - Published2 September Under certain conditions, BfV agents will also be permitted to enter homes covertly. However, the measure must always be authorised in advance. They will also be given wider powers of digital surveillance, including monitoring encrypted telecommunications and carrying out online searches. They will also be allowed to use AI-supported data analysis and biometric image matching on the internet. The government says the reform is needed because of an increase in foreign espionage, particularly from Russia, China and Iran. "We are the target of hybrid threats," said Dobrindt. "Germany is a theatre of operations for terrorism, extremism and foreign powers." In August, a drone carrying an explosive device was discovered at Leipzig Airport, close to Ukrainian cargo planes. However, it failed to explode as the bomb's detonator was apparently faulty. German authorities say Russia was behind the attack. The new law has been bitterly criticised by some opposition politicians, even though Dobrindt has said it is "madness" to think it means that Germany is creating a new secret police. And Clara Bünger from the Left Party told public broadcaster ARD that the new law was "a monster… summoning ghosts that we will probably never be able to get rid of". The separation between the police and the secret service, she warned, was "being eroded" - and Bünger said that had been a lesson learned from the Nazi era. "This means the secret service is being granted executive powers and will not only be allowed to act pre-emptively, but will also be granted police powers." However, Sonja Eichwede of the centre-left SPD, which is part of Germany's governing coalition, said the reforms would make a significant contribution to ensuring the country's democracy was "robust and resilient".

articles.summaryTr: Several of the deceased are college students, according to local official Atul Bora, but they have not yet been publicly identified.
articles.articleText: At least 24 killed after bus collides with truck in north-east India - Published At least 24 people have died and 11 others injured after a bus collided with a truck in Assam, north-east India. The accident happened near Kaziranga National Park, a Unesco World Heritage site, and the injured have been admitted to Jorhat Medical College and Hospital. Several of the deceased are college students, according to Assam's rural development minister Atul Bora, but they have not yet been publicly identified. Bora added that witnesses reported one of the vehicles may have been speeding when the crash took place, but "the exact reason will be known after [an investigation]". Assam chief minister Himanta Biswa Sarma wrote in a post on X that "the scale of this loss has shaken all of us". He adds: "Our foremost priority now is to make sure the injured receive the best possible medical care without delay." The bus was carrying passengers from Bokakhat and was headed towards Nagaon. Bokakhat is best known as the gateway to Kaziranga National Park, famous for its one-horned rhinoceroses. Nagaon is an important agricultural and commercial centre in central Assam, about 120km (74.5 miles) west of Bokakhat by road. Lurinjyoti Gogoi, chief of a regional opposition party, said road safety has long been a major concern in the state. "The government must take it up seriously," he said. Road accidents are responsible for thousands of deaths in India every year. In 2023, 172,000 people lost their lives on Indian roads, or 474 a day – roughly one every three minutes. The count increased to 183,382 deaths in 2025. Experts say the crisis is rooted not just in infrastructure but in human behaviour, enforcement gaps and systemic neglect. - Published21 April 2025

articles.titleTr: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.summaryTr: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
articles.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto, Jane Street increased its share count in Fidelity’s spot Bitcoin ETF nearly eightfold in the third quarter, US President Donald Trump nominated four new SEC and CFTC commissioners, including a replacement for prominent crypto advocate Hester Peirce and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang abruptly resigned. Jane Street boosts Fidelity Bitcoin ETF holdings nearly 8x, trims IBIT Jane Street’s share count in Fidelity’s spot Bitcoin exchange-traded fund (ETF) rose nearly eightfold in the third quarter, while its holdings in BlackRock’s fund fell 19%. The trading giant ended September with 7.01 million shares of Fidelity Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC0, up from about 887,000 at the end of June. The position was worth $509 million on Sept. 30, according to its second-quarter and third-quarter filings. Jane Street’s holdings in BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (IBIT) fell to 20.22 million shares from 24.88 million. A higher share price lifted the reported value of its stake to $957 million from $828 million. Jane Street was the largest reported institutional holder of BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF at the end of June after boosting its share count by 324% in Q2, according to 13F Pro. IBIT is the world’s largest spot Bitcoin ETF with $56 billion in net assets as of Thursday. The firm also added nearly 9 million shares (about $249 million) of the ARK 21Shares Bitcoin ETF (ARKB), while more than doubling its holdings in BlackRock’s iShares Ethereum Trust ETF (ETHA) by 7.83 million shares (about $158 million). Trump nominates Hester Peirce successor among SEC, CFTC picks US President Donald Trump has nominated Steven Levine to replace former Securities and Exchange Commission Commissioner Hester Peirce, one of the agency’s most prominent crypto advocates, as part of four nominations to fill vacancies at the SEC and Commodity Futures Trading Commission. The White House’s latest announcement on Thursday named two nominees each for the SEC and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, agencies whose decisions help shape US cryptocurrency regulation, among other functions. All four nominations require Senate confirmation. The nominations would replenish several commissioner roles. The SEC currently has only two of its five commissioner seats filled, while CFTC Chairman Michael Selig is the sole member of his agency’s five-seat commission. The nominations come weeks before Democrats are set to take control of the Senate in January, giving a narrow window for Republicans to confirm Trump’s picks. Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, exits board; shares plunge Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as president and CEO and stepped down from the company’s board on Thursday, effective immediately. The board named Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress interim CEO. Kress will retain her role as CFO while Nvidia’s board considers internal and external candidates for the permanent CEO role. The board also appointed Harvey C. Jones its first chair and said it expects Nvidia’s operations to proceed without interruption. Nvidia shares fell more than 13% shortly after the US market opened on Thursday, trading at $151.00 as of 2:31 p.m. UTC, according to Yahoo Finance. Bitcoin (BTC) fell alongside Nvidia shares, dropping as much as 3.5% to a multimonth low. The shares later pared losses to trade at $165 at 4:24 p.m. UTC, down 5% on the day. The stock was down more than 26% over the previous month.

articles.title: Arthur Hayes ‘flattered’ as Coinbase backs US stock perps
articles.summary: Arthur Hayes said he was “flattered” by Coinbase’s defense of US stock perpetual futures, a decade after BitMEX launched perpetual swaps.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Arthur Hayes ‘flattered’ as Coinbase backs US stock perps
articles.summaryTr: Arthur Hayes said he was “flattered” by Coinbase’s defense of US stock perpetual futures, a decade after BitMEX launched perpetual swaps.
articles.articleText: Arthur Hayes ‘flattered’ as Coinbase backs US stock perps Arthur Hayes said he was “flattered” by Coinbase’s defense of US stock perpetual futures, a decade after BitMEX launched perpetual swaps. Arthur Hayes, co-founder of BitMEX, said he was “flattered” by Coinbase’s support for the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) in a US legal dispute over stock perpetual futures. “When we launched the perpetual swap at BitMEX in 2016, Washington’s reaction was less than warm,” Hayes told Cointelegraph. “Ten years later, Coinbase is in federal court defending the right to offer them on US stocks. I’m flattered. Imitation is the sincerest form of regulation.” Coinbase and five other companies submitted a brief on Monday opposing the alliance’s request to block trading in perpetual futures tied to individual stocks. The court accepted the brief on Tuesday. The Capital Markets Alliance Association (CMAA), which brought the lawsuit, says the contracts should be treated as security-based swaps, which face tighter restrictions on retail trading. Hayes was CEO of BitMEX when the crypto derivatives exchange launched its Bitcoin perpetual swap, which let traders take leveraged positions on Bitcoin without a fixed expiration date. The product helped make perpetual swaps a staple of crypto trading. SEC weighs in on stock perpetuals The US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) reportedly submitted a proposed court brief on Monday, opposing the alliance’s request to temporarily halt trading in the contracts. The agency said it was reviewing the exchanges’ rules for listing the contracts. The brief left open whether the SEC would set those rules aside and whether the contracts qualify as security futures or security-based swaps. Related: EU DeFi proposals could push users to riskier platforms, says Coinbase exec In a Tuesday court filing, CMAA said that the CFTC had approved the contracts without adequately explaining its decision or addressing unresolved regulatory questions. The group also cited about $375 million in reported 24-hour notional trading volume for Kalshi’s stock perpetuals shortly after launch, claiming the products were already diverting business from traditional stock markets. Stock perpetuals’ lack of expiry is at issue Stock perpetuals let traders speculate on individual share prices without owning the underlying stocks. Unlike traditional futures, the contracts have no fixed expiration date. On Nov. 3, US District Judge Valerie Caproni denied the group’s request for a temporary restraining order because it had yet to show likely irreparable harm. She found the alliance was likely to succeed on its claim that the CFTC exceeded its authority. Wojciech Kaszycki, strategy adviser to BTCS SA, said the lack of a fixed expiration or delivery date could complicate the case for treating perpetual contracts as futures. Kaszycki told Cointelegraph that the case “sale for future delivery.” However, he warned that a ruling against the CFTC could push trading activity toward offshore and decentralized platforms. “The product doesn’t die; it just changes address,” he said. articles.title: Aide to fugitive Ukrainian ex-PM wounded in latest Moscow car bombing
articles.summary: Sergei Zavorotny, now a journalist and commentator, was previously an adviser to Ukrainian ex-prime minister Mykola Azarov.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Aide to fugitive Ukrainian ex-PM wounded in latest Moscow car bombing
articles.summaryTr: Sergei Zavorotny, now a journalist and commentator, was previously an adviser to Ukrainian ex-prime minister Mykola Azarov.
articles.articleText: Aide to fugitive Ukrainian ex-PM wounded in latest Moscow car bombing - Published A car bomb attack in Moscow has wounded a former adviser to Ukrainian ex-prime minister Mykola Azarov, Russia's Investigative Committee says. Sergei Zavorotny, now a journalist and commentator, was behind the wheel of his black Toyota when the explosion happened and Azarov told Russian TV his condition in hospital was "rather critical". The car bomb went off a day after a Russian colonel was killed in another explosion in St Petersburg, and both blasts are seen as part of a series of attacks on military and prominent figures linked to Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine. Zavorotny, 72, worked as a press aide to Mykola Azarov in Kyiv until 2014. But when pro-Kremlin Ukrainian president Viktor Yanukovych was toppled from power, Azarov fled Kyiv for Russia and tried unsuccessfully to set up a government in exile. In a 2020 US Senate report on interference in the 2016 American presidential election, Zavorotny is described at the time as an SVR [Russian foreign intelligence] officer involved in influence operations. Russia's Investigative Committee said on Telegram on Friday: "Serhiy Zavorotny, a former adviser to the former Ukrainian Prime Minister Mykola Azarov, was injured while driving a car. He was taken to one of the city hospitals, where he is receiving medical care." It added: "A set of necessary investigative actions is being carried out. A number of examinations will be appointed, including medical and explosives." According to several unconfirmed reports, Zavorotny suffered a number of serious injuries after an explosive device was detonated remotely. Russia said the car bombs are the latest in a series of attacks targeting pro-Kremlin figures. On Thursday a car bomb in the Pushkinsky District of St Petersburg killed a member of the Russian military, again after it was attached to the base of the car and detonated remotely. The man targeted in the attack is yet to be named officially, but reputable sources suggest he was a high-ranking figure in the 6th Guards Air and Air Defence Forces Army. Overnight into Friday, Ukraine and Russia exchanged attacks on each other's territories. Ukrainian authorities said a hospital had been targeted by Russian bombardment. They added that three people, including a 17-year-old boy, were also killed in attacks across southern Odesa and Zaporizhzhia. Russia said a Ukrainian strike on an industrial facility in the central Samara region killed four people. And in the southern Volgograd region another four died after an industrial zone was hit by drones. A further person died in the Bryansk border region, an area that is often fired upon. Ukraine said these were retaliatory attacks in response to Russia's persistent targeting of its cities. Related topics - Published1 day ago - Published1 day ago

On Thursday a car bomb in the Pushkinsky District of St Petersburg killed a member of the Russian military, again after it was attached to the base of the car and detonated remotely. The man targeted in the attack is yet to be named officially, but reputable sources suggest he was a high-ranking figure in the 6th Guards Air and Air Defence Forces Army. Overnight into Friday, Ukraine and Russia exchanged attacks on each other's territories. Ukrainian authorities said a hospital had been targeted by Russian bombardment. They added that three people, including a 17-year-old boy, were also killed in attacks across southern Odesa and Zaporizhzhia. Russia said a Ukrainian strike on an industrial facility in the central Samara region killed four people. And in the southern Volgograd region another four died after an industrial zone was hit by drones. A further person died in the Bryansk border region, an area that is often fired upon. Ukraine said these were retaliatory attacks in response to Russia's persistent targeting of its cities. Related topics - Published1 day ago - Published1 day ago

articles.titleTr: Nakamoto shares fall 6% premarket after Q3 revenue turns negative
articles.summaryTr: A $5.8 million Bitcoin options loss pushed Nakamoto’s quarterly operating revenue below zero, while the company extended repayment of $60 million in Kraken debt to 2027.
articles.articleText: Nakamoto shares fall 6% premarket after Q3 revenue turns negative A $5.8 million Bitcoin options loss pushed Nakamoto’s quarterly operating revenue below zero, while the company extended repayment of $60 million in Kraken debt to 2027. Update (Nov. 13 at 19:04 UTC): This article has been updated to include details of Nakamoto’s amended loan agreement with Kraken. Shares in Nasdaq-listed Bitcoin treasury company Nakamoto fell 6.5% in premarket trading on Friday after the company reported that losses on Bitcoin options pushed third-quarter operating revenue below zero. Nakamoto also extended the repayment deadline for $60 million in Bitcoin-backed debt owed to Kraken by one year. Nakamoto’s shares traded at $5.40 at 12:02 pm UTC on Friday, according to Yahoo Finance. At that price, the stock was down about 62% year to date. Nakamoto reported its third-quarter results after the market closed on Thursday. The company generated $3.9 million in revenue from its businesses. A $5.8 million net loss on Bitcoin options brought total operating revenue to negative $1.9 million, according to its quarterly filing. Analysts had expected about $17.4 million in revenue, according to estimates compiled by Yahoo Finance. Nakamoto reported $85.5 million in net income and a $15.8 million adjusted operating loss for the quarter. A $110.4 million gain from revaluing its digital assets, chiefly Bitcoin (BTC), drove the profit. The adjusted operating loss excludes that gain. Nakamoto held 4,283 BTC worth $357.9 million as of Sept. 30, down from 4,467 BTC at the end of June. Nakamoto extends $60M Kraken loan repayment to 2027 Nakamoto also disclosed that it had extended the repayment deadline for $60 million in Tether USDt (USDT) owed to crypto exchange Kraken by one year, from Dec. 4, 2026, to Dec. 4, 2027, according to an SEC filing. The amendment leaves the company’s total outstanding debt to Kraken unchanged at 165 million USDT, with the remaining 105 million USDT due June 30, 2027. No principal repayments are scheduled for 2026. The revised agreement also allows the positive net value of certain Bitcoin derivative positions held with Kraken to count toward collateral requirements, potentially helping Nakamoto offset declines in the value of its pledged Bitcoin before it must provide additional collateral or repay part of the loan. Nakamoto had pledged 3,030 BTC as collateral at the end of September, representing about 71% of its total holdings, according to its quarterly report. Related: Nakamoto taps Bitwise and Kraken for Bitcoin options strategy to hedge risk

articles.title: Israeli police arrest five in $5M WhatsApp crypto trading probe
articles.summary: Police suspect the group drew up fictitious loan agreements to disguise crypto trading proceeds it transferred directly into bank accounts.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Israeli police arrest five in $5M WhatsApp crypto trading probe
articles.summaryTr: Police suspect the group drew up fictitious loan agreements to disguise crypto trading proceeds it transferred directly into bank accounts.
articles.articleText: Israeli police arrest five in $5M WhatsApp crypto trading probe Police suspect the group drew up fictitious loan agreements to disguise crypto trading proceeds it transferred directly into bank accounts. Israeli police arrested five people on Tuesday in a money laundering investigation involving about 16 million shekels ($5 million) in crypto transactions arranged through a WhatsApp group. Investigators from the National Unit for Combating Economic Crime within Lahav 433 suspect the group provided crypto services without a license and failed to report transactions to Israel’s tax authorities. Police allege the group used fictitious agreements to make crypto proceeds transferred into bank accounts look like loans, according to The Jerusalem Post. Authorities seized wallets, computers and tens of thousands of shekels in cash while searching the suspects’ homes. Investigators questioned the five on suspicion of money laundering, fraud and providing financial asset services without a license. Israel’s Tax Authority announced two other arrests on Oct. 6 in cases involving suspected failures to report crypto activity. One involved trades worth tens of millions of dollars. In the other, an Ashdod resident allegedly failed to report income from about $13 million in crypto trades between 2019 and 2021. A November 2024 audit by Israel’s State Comptroller found that about 500 people reported crypto activity each year on average from 2018 to 2022, out of at least 200,000 potential filers. Related: DOJ moves to seize $1.2B from Binance hack, disrupts FaceStealer scam

articles.title: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
articles.articleText: Release Number 9324-26 CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers November 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced eight orders filing and settling charges against Michael Talento, Anthony Tyler Williams, Quillan Roberto Black, Christopher Williams, Michael Levi Peters, Jordan Taylor Morgan, Lewis Matthew Neal, and Tyler Evan MacKechnie for acting as unregistered associated persons of unregistered foreign introducing brokers. According to the orders, the introducing brokers engaged in the solicitation of orders for off-exchange leveraged or margined retail foreign currency and retail commodities transactions with U.S. customers who were not eligible contract participants. The respondents solicited those customers without registering as associated persons of the introducing brokers, as required. Under the orders, the respondents must cease and desist from engaging in their illegal conduct. They also are barred for two years from registering with the Commission in any capacity or acting as a principal, agent, or employee of any CFTC registrant. Each order also recognizes the penalty the respondent owes in a related Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding. These orders relate to a prior Commission order sanctioning Netrios LP Ltd. and Red Acre Ltd. for facilitating illegal off-exchange commodity transactions with U.S. customers. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9263-26] The SEC has filed and settled charges against the respondents based on the same underlying conduct. The CFTC thanks the SEC for its assistance. -CFTC-
